faq_heading: Questions founders ask about a LinkedIn agent versus an SDR

faqs.q: Can a LinkedIn outreach agent replace an SDR?
faqs.a: It can replace the repetitive prospecting part: finding buyers, sending personal messages, following up and sorting replies. It does not replace discovery calls, demos or closing, which a person should still own.

faqs.q: How long does an SDR take to start producing pipeline?
faqs.a: It varies by company. A new SDR first has to be hired, then learn the product, the buyer and the tone, so pipeline usually starts well after the start date. An agent setup is quicker: we aim to show a first demo within 7 days.

faqs.q: Is it safe to use an AI agent on LinkedIn?
faqs.a: It is safer when the agent behaves like a careful person: modest daily volume, personal messages, pauses between actions and no more messages once someone replies. LinkedIn restricts spam-style automation, so high-volume blasting is the real risk.

faqs.q: Should I hire an SDR and use an agent together?
faqs.a: Often that works well. The agent keeps the top of the funnel full every day, and the SDR spends time on the warm replies, calls and follow-up that need judgment.

faqs.q: Who sees the replies when an agent runs my outreach?
faqs.a: You do. Warm replies are tagged the same day and passed to your founder or sales head on WhatsApp with the conversation, so a person can take over quickly.
